facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT, Postal and Courier Services of Zimbabwe says the Kadoma Draft of the National AI Strategy 2026-2030 was interrogated and validated at a National Multi-Stakeholder Consultation held in Harare on 28 August 2025, Bulawayo on 9 September 2025 and Masvingo on 11 September 2025, and credits input from academia, the private sector, civil society and diaspora representatives alongside government and development partners.
